title: Youjo Senki II

thread.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2 • Youjo Senki II - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Many viewers considered the finale exciting, especially praising its intensity, surprises, and strong visual presentation.
Several commenters enjoyed the season's political and geopolitical focus, though some preferred the action.
Tanya was frequently admired as a capable, entertaining, and resilient protagonist.
Some viewers found the season rushed and felt that too much material was skipped.
A few commenters found the finale boring or had only mediocre overall enjoyment.
The political material was interesting to some viewers but confusing or emotionally distant to others.
Viewers broadly wanted another season, while expressing concern about a potentially long wait.

title: Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Itsuwari no Yuusha Denshou

thread.title: Clevatess Season 2 • Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha Denshou - Episode 12 discussion

opinions.point: The episode’s major lore revelations were widely praised as surprising, ambitious, and satisfying.
Many viewers enjoyed the unusual treatment of the hero and demon-lord mythology, especially the emotional history between the central figures.
Clevatess being genuinely challenged in combat was considered refreshing and entertaining.
The character humor and expressive reactions were frequently appreciated.
The practical-looking effects and miniature-style action presentation drew enthusiastic praise.
Some viewers liked the restrained reveal structure, while others felt the episode withheld or compressed material they wanted to see.
The short runtime and abrupt cliffhanger frustrated several commenters.

notes: The title explicitly identifies Clevatess II, Season 2, and episode 12, though it uses the subtitle 'Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha Denshou' rather than the alternate subtitle in the target label. Comments were accessible through the specified r/anime thread and were paraphrased without plot spoilers.
